title: A short exact sequence starting with an injective object splits
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] and $0\to I\xrightarrow{i}E\xrightarrow{p}C\to0$ a short exact sequence in $\mathcal A$ with $I$ an injective object [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Then the sequence splits: there are morphisms $\pi:E\to I$ and $s:C\to E$ with $\pi\circ i=\mathrm{id}_I$, $p\circ s=\mathrm{id}_C$ and $i\circ\pi+s\circ p=\mathrm{id}_E$.
